text: Based on the provided tool output, Hansen did record tree-cover loss within the property in 2021. The total area of tree-cover loss was approximately 81.3 hectares. This observation was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data, which agreed on 98% of the event area. However, it's important to note that this data does not specify the cause of the loss or whether it was legal or illegal. Additionally, some loss in patches under 0.5 hectares in 2021 were not counted as an event.
